title: Salon Two-Way SMS Messaging | Bella Booking Australia

facts.fact: Messages Plus is the marketing and retention add-on and is charged per location on top of any paid plan.
facts.quote: Messages Plus is the marketing and retention add-on, charged per location on top of any paid plan

facts.fact: Vendor's listed Professional plan price for a salon with 5 team members using two-way messaging at the front desk is A$99 per month.
Vendor states its Professional plan has no per-seat fees and no commission.
Vendor offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
facts.quote: Start your 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

facts.fact: Email campaigns are unlimited within Messages Plus, subject to fair use.
facts.quote: Email campaigns are unlimited within Messages Plus (fair use)

facts.fact: The two-way inbox, campaigns, birthday and new-client programmes, and the two post-appointment follow-up messages require the Messages Plus add-on, while the appointment lifecycle sends on every plan without it.
facts.quote: the two follow-up messages that check in after an appointment

facts.fact: Plans include a monthly SMS allowance, and Messages Plus credit packs and optional auto-top-up cover volume beyond that allowance.
facts.quote: Plans include a monthly SMS allowance

facts.fact: SMS usage consumes credits measured in segments, and high-volume campaign months need enough credit balance.
Replying YES or YES / CONFIRM can automatically confirm an appointment.
facts.quote: YES / CONFIRM can confirm the appointment

facts.fact: Replying STOP stops all SMS to that client, including reminders, confirmations, and marketing, while NO PROMOS / STOP MARKETING is the marketing-only opt-out.
facts.quote: For marketing-only opt-out, clients use NO PROMOS / STOP MARKETING.

facts.fact: The New message notification is on by default for owners and admins, and each team member can switch it on or off.
facts.quote: It is on by default for owners and admins

facts.fact: Before sending, Bella checks SMS against anti-spam rules and email for spam-trigger words and deliverability, and Bella's drafted campaigns are never auto-sent.
facts.quote: Before send, Bella checks SMS against anti-spam rules and email for spam-trigger words and deliverability.

facts.fact: Threads in the shared inbox are organised by client, with optional internal notes for the team.
facts.quote: Threads are organised by client in the shared inbox, with optional internal notes for your team.
